Author: gonsolo_
Content: I am considering buying a 1x0.5 slot with chip on board packaging for my open source GPU. How am i supposed to test it then? I didn't find anything on the website. Do I have to design my own board? Can I use a Tiny Tapeout board? Can I connect it to my ULX3S FPGA?

Author: mole99
Content:
You will need to design your own motherboard according to the requirements of your chip.

Here is mine, which is based on an older Tiny Tapeout board: https://github.com/mole99/waferspace-main-pcb
